title: Cisco security advisory (AV26-1102)
description: As of October 28, 2026, Cisco is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA)
	Versions prior to 9.16.4.104, 9.18.4.96, 9.20.4.50, 9.22.3.200, 9.23.1.4, 9.24.1.27 and 9.24.10.1

Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)
	Versions prior to 7.0.11, 7.2.13, 7.4.9, 7.6.7, 7.7.14, 10.0.3 and 10.1.1

Cisco Network Management and Provisioning License (Smart Software Manager) On-Prem
	Versions prior to 10-202610
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
